additional_concerns: The transition preserves processing of existing applications. It does not expressly establish a permanent substantive disqualification for every change associated with an application pending at commencement. Candidates that make historical pending status a decisive false result encode an unresolved inference.

The candidates deliberately place commencement and legacy status in different stages. A pre-effective assessment or legacy application can therefore yield FALSE in one candidate and OUT_OF_SCOPE in another. Those outputs answer different typed questions and are not interchangeable.

The specific commencement paragraph supports 28 November 2025. The introductory reference to immediate effect does not supply a universal implementation-event test; candidate node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e should clarify the distinction between assessment date and proposed implementation date.
Neither supplied missing dependency ID identifies its document. No mapping to the FAQs, forms or other authority can be inferred from these opaque IDs.

Home-jurisdiction compliance and the classification of novel or complex features and possible local policy implications remain supplied judgments. Applying these predicates to an actual change requires applicable home-jurisdiction requirements and relevant SFC guidance, neither of which is supplied.

The introductory home-supervision language describes the measures' purpose; item (ii) expressly uses home-requirements compliance. A separate supervision condition is not clearly established and should not be silently added.

No candidate establishes withdrawal, resubmission, severability or the effect of subsequent application decisions. Notification, filing and post-vetting remain distinct from the selected relief questions.
